profile.headline: Solution/Enterprise/Data Architect, Senior Database/Oracle PLSQL/BI/Software Developer/Technical team lead

positions.title: Solution/Enterprise Architect, Technical Team Leader-Sr. Software developer
positions.description:
 Develop and provide the architecture solutions to Ford IT applications
 Lead the Architecture Strategy development and delivery such as GCP, AWS, Azure, Container, SaaS,
PCF, serverless applications, microservices, restful service, etc
 Provide the consultation to the vendor/production solution evaluation process
 Drive for proactive engagement and ownership of architecture deliverables
 Lead, advocate and implement the latest cutting-edge technologies for IT
applications/platforms/frameworks
 Work with business partners helping them define solutions to business problems
 Work with cross-functional departments to help define solution architecture and provide, deliver &
implement the best solutions to the IT applications/systems
 Provide governance of architecture deliverables to ensure Ford standards are met and processes are
followed
 Provide the consultation/solution/troubleshooting to project teams as well as application performance
issues
 Lead and deliver the architecture solutions to DCOF (Data Center Of Future) migration for many applications
 Architect & launch the new system ‘Recall Investigation VIN Attribute Tool’ (RIVAT) in 2020 and
it was officially accepted as a US patent in early 2022

positions.title: Technical Team Leader-Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
 Manage, develop, enhance, configure and support applications in Ford Asset Management System
(FCAMS), Connect-IT and Discovery and Dependency Mapping Inventory (DDMI).
 Produce complex code and database integration for various source data into data management systems.
 Design and create ETL programs/code, data process and Oracle database development with PL/SQL
 Data modeling, Oracle database and BI report development with PL/SQL and other tools
 Design, develop and implement application enhancements and CIRs (Continuous Improvement
Requests) to meet business needs
 Lead the team and provide architectural/technical suggestions/approaches/guidance to the team on
FCAMS enhancements/incidents/problems.
 Serve as project manager and lead the reviews of design, code and test case
 Diagnose, troubleshoot and provide the technical consultation/support for the applications
 Work with cross-functional departments/teams to handle day-to-day operations
 Ensure appropriate use of Ford IT processes, tools and methodologies
 Create and maintain application and controls documentation
 Communicate effectively with customers on a day-to-day basis
 Use of problem-solving skills to analyze/resolve incidents and problems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Lead/Architect
positions.description:
 Database, Oracle Forms development with Oracle Developer Suite 10g and PL/SQL programs
 Design, develop, enhance and validate sophisticated Veteran Administration applications using Oracle
Forms Builder, etc of Oracle Developer Suite 10g and PL/SQL
 Interact with Unix, create and modify the shell scripts to compile the Oracle Forms
 Analyze BRD (Business Requirement Document) and RSD (Requirement Specification Document).
Use those documents as input for SDD (System Design Document)
 Design, develop and create System Design Document with detailed software design, software
components and diagrams, etc
 Diagnose, troubleshoot and provide the technical consultation/support for all complex database or
software issues/solutions
 As a remote worker I interact/communicate with different group of people from various regions to
conduct work virtually and efficiently

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst(Data Warehouse/Business Intelligence)/IT/Software/Data Architect
positions.description:
 Database, Oracle development with PL/SQL including procedures, functions, triggers, packages, etc.
SQL development of programs/queries
 Tune and optimize the SQL programs/procedures and queries. Implement indexes, partitions, etc
 Conduct data architecture and data warehousing work. Design and create database objects including
tables, views, indexes, constraints, sequences to meet business requirements. Set/enforce database
standards and practices
 Conduct ETL with INFORMATICA or Oracle utilities such as SQL Loader, etc
 Establish the automated process by creating PL/SQL, SQL programs, queries, procedures and the
control files to manipulate/extract the data based on the business requirements
 Develop scripts/programs to manipulate data using Unix
 Create Shell Scripts and batch files in Unix to run PL/SQL programs to automate the process
 Design, build, implement, and support solutions that meet the analytical and reporting needs of the
business.
 Investigate software and data problems, correct immediate effects and provide long-term solutions.
Determine testing needed to assure the functionality and integrity of reporting solutions, create and
execute test plans, evaluate and document testing results taking corrective action as necessary
 Diagnose, troubleshoot and provide the technical consultation and production support
